instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.step in BRL-CAD. Generate only a matching lid aligned to the enclosure opening. The enclosure opening is centered at X=53 mm and Y=38 mm, and the enclosure top plane is Z=30 mm. The lid outer outline must be 99.6 x 69.6 mm, with lid thickness 6 mm; place the lid bottom face on Z=30 mm and its top face on Z=36 mm. Add four locating posts on the underside, each post with diameter 6 mm and length 8 mm, extending downward from Z=30 mm to Z=22 mm. The post centers form an 80 x 50 mm rectangle centered on the opening, at X=13 and X=93 mm and Y=13 and Y=63 mm. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
